description: "Laura Jones, a lifelong Texan, Army mom, and small business owner, is running for US Congress in Texas District 8. With firsthand experience of the challenges facing working families, Laura advocates for equal access to quality education, defends individual freedoms, and believes healthcare is a basic human right. Join her mission for positive change."
